label: late-episode D1 (sparse); strongest on switching to a1 after an unrewarded a2 trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), and almost only late in the episode (ep_trial >= 50 holds 99% of mass, peaking at trials 70-89), yet on just ~1.4% of D1 steps. It is enriched after unrewarded trials (prev_reward=0 has 77% of mass), when the upcoming choice is a1, at low-to-mid value (5.2-7.1) and moderately positive choice logit, and it never fires at GO or D2. The clearest sub-pattern is D1 where the agent is about to switch to a1 after an unrewarded a2 trial (dev precision 0.61 but recall only 0.25, mass recall 0.35). The predicate uses action, the agent own upcoming choice at D1 (marked FUTURE but computed by the agent); no future reward or transition is used. Broad predicates (late D1 after no reward) reach mass recall 0.73 but precision 0.07, so most activations remain unexplained; the episode-time dependence suggests it tracks slow hidden-state drift rather than a crisp task variable.
